title: Remote Engineering Manager (Algorithms Team) (m/f/d)
description:
About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

Your Role

As an Engineering Manager for the Algorithms team (Revenue Management Engine) at RoomPriceGenie, you will build and lead the team behind the core of our product: the pricing and forecasting engine that automatically prices rooms for thousands of hotels. This is the algorithmic and data heart of RoomPriceGenie, spanning the pricing algorithm, the forecasting models and the data pipelines that feed them.

This is a leadership role. Your focus is the team: delivery, people and the connection to product goals. You stay technically credible and close to the work through design and code review, and you get hands-on when the team needs it, but you are not coding day to day. You balance delivery speed with long-term technical health and build an environment of trust and accountability. The role also reaches beyond your own team: we want you leading the way on technical improvements at the Product and Engineering department level, things like engineering processes and operational excellence, as a hands-on driver.

You will work closely with a Product Manager and report to the Senior Engineering Manager. A core part of the job is turning a complex, data-heavy domain into reliable, measurable outcomes: shipping model and pipeline improvements, proving their impact through backtesting and clear quality metrics, and keeping pricing runs dependable at scale. We expect you to be a genuine partner to Product, able to challenge and shape what gets built, not only how.

Who you'll lead

You will lead a team of 4 engineers (3 Senior and 1 Staff). The role may also grow to include an Associate Engineering Manager over time.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and lead a high-performing team across the pricing algorithm, forecasting and data pipelines, owning delivery, quality and the operational health of pricing runs.

  • Grow your people through regular 1:1s, feedback, performance reviews and career development.

  • Hire, onboard and develop engineers to keep the team balanced and strong.

  • Partner closely with Product and challenge them: push back on direction, bring your own point of view and drive changes to what the team builds, not just how it builds.

  • Translate business goals into clear engineering plans with measurable outcomes and realistic timelines. Use data (backtesting, model quality, before and after signals) to guide prioritisation.

  • Balance delivery velocity with technical sustainability, addressing debt, scalability and reliability as part of delivery rather than after it.

  • Provide technical oversight through design and code review, staying close enough to guide architecture and quality and to get hands-on when the team genuinely needs it.

  • Act as a buffer between the team and external pressure, keeping focus and healthy team dynamics.

  • Improve engineering processes and practices to increase clarity, alignment and predictable delivery.

  • Lead technical improvements beyond your own team, at the Product and Engineering department level, for example engineering processes and operational excellence. We want you hands-on and driving these, not only sponsoring them.

Your Profile

  • Strong software engineering background with a track record of building and operating production systems, ideally with depth in backend and data-intensive or algorithmic domains.

  • At least 5 years of experience, with several years genuinely managing engineers, including performance management. This is a role for an experienced manager, not a first step into leadership.

  • Experience growing or managing other managers, for example an Associate Engineering Manager or Team Leads, is a plus.

  • A strong product mindset with the confidence to challenge Product. You enjoy defining problems and validating solutions with PMs and you are comfortable disagreeing, proposing alternatives and driving them to a decision.

  • Technically credible and willing to get hands-on when the team needs it, while spending most of your time leading rather than in the code day to day.

  • Comfortable with our stack: Python/Django on the backend, with a data stack around Snowflake, dbt and Dagster. Exposure to forecasting, modelling or data engineering is a strong plus.

  • Strong grasp of system design, architecture and engineering best practices.

  • Excellent communication and leadership: you create clarity, trust and accountability, with a servant-leadership mindset toward your team.

  • You look beyond your own team and enjoy driving technical improvements that raise the bar across the wider Product and Engineering org.

title: Staff/Senior Software Engineer - Hydris - Golang (d/f/m)
description:
New Challenge

About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a Germany-based DefenseTech company with offices in Berlin and Munich. We network market-available sensors, effectors, or situational awareness systems into a tactical IoT backbone that reliably provides armed forces and security agencies with cross-domain information superiority — automated, scalable, and cost-efficient.

Our solutions integrate seamlessly into existing defense and maritime infrastructures, delivering fast data fusion and AI-enhanced analytics for robust situational awareness in dynamic environments. We build platform-agnostic systems that enable real interoperability across domains.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll directly impact the technical direction of our orchestration products – Hydris – the coordination engine for sensors and mission systems, and the interoperability API that underpins it. 

You'll work at the layer where heterogeneous real-world systems like radars, AIS receivers, LoRa mesh radios, satellite feeds, and C2 platforms become a single coherent picture. The problems lie in distributed systems, protocols, and data modeling areas. They play out in environments that are bandwidth-constrained, intermittently connected, and operationally unforgiving. 

The role is deeply hands-on, but it expects you to shape what we build and how we build it, not just deliver what's specified.

What you'll do
Core engine development

  • Design and build the systems that power Hydris.
  • Go is your primary language. You should be comfortable reading Rust and TypeScript across the codebase, even if you're not writing in them day-to-day.
  • Own the architecture of a system that must run reliably on edge hardware, in disconnected mesh networks, and at scale — often all of that simultaneously.
Protocol and integration architecture
  • Evolve the schema that defines how every sensor, asset, and mission system talks to Hydris.
  • Make API design decisions that hold up across our client libraries without creating a maintenance burden.
  • Continue refining the integration framework that lets Hydris connect to new sensor types, data sources, and command systems.
  • Set the patterns for how built-in integrations (ADS-B, AIS, ASTERIX, Meshtastic, SpaceTrack, TAK, federation) are structured, tested, and maintained.
  • Make it straightforward for external developers and system vendors to build their own plugins/integrations to Hydris.
Distributed systems
  • Architect the peer-to-peer mesh and federation layer that keeps Hydris operational in disconnected, denied, intermittent, and limited-bandwidth environments.
  • Solve the hard coordination problems: conflict resolution across federated nodes, eventual consistency of entity state, and track correlation across unreliable links.
  • Ensure the system degrades gracefully rather than failing completely when connectivity is lost or constrained.
Technical leadership
  • Set technical standards for the codebase: how we test distributed behavior, how we handle protocol versioning, how we think about backward compatibility in an API-first product.
  • Review code with a focus on long-term maintainability and operational correctness, not just feature completion.
  • Make build-versus-integrate decisions and help the team clearly understand the trade-offs.

You should apply if you
  • Have built and shipped distributed systems that run in production, ideally in environments where reliability matters more than convenience.
  • Are comfortable working across the stack, from Protobuf schema design and systems-level Go, to the TypeScript that puts a map in front of a user.
  • Have well-formed views about API design and protocol evolution, informed by experience maintaining APIs that other people depend on.
  • Can operate effectively with a high degree of autonomy but are adept at collaboration with colleagues toward high-quality technical decisions, at scale.
  • Are interested in contributing to European military, maritime, and critical infrastructure defence systems.
  • Write clearly and communicate architectural decisions in a way that survives beyond the conversation where they were made. 
  • Working language is English. German is not required.
You'd be a great fit with

  • Familiarity with defense or ISR data standards like CoT/TAK, ASTERIX, SAPIENT, MIL-STD-2525.
  • Background in networking, mesh architectures, or systems designed for contested or degraded communication environments.
  • Experience working on developer-facing open-source infrastructure where adoption depends on the quality of the API and documentation.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.

Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.

Your Mission

You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.

As a Senior Project Manager, you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.

At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.

You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.

We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.

Your Career Path in Project Management

This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.

  • Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management.

  • Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs.

  • Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.

Key Responsibilities

  • Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

  • Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

  • Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

  • Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

  • Own scope actively. Recognize a change request for what it is and handle it deliberately.

  • Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

  • Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

In addition, as a Senior Project Manager

  • Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

  • Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

  • Run the steering committee and own the decisions that come out of it.

  • Write and execute the recovery plan when a program is off track.

  • Lead the blp team on each engagement and coach the Project Managers working on your programs.

What We're Really Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Scope Discipline – You notice when a project is quietly growing, and you raise it rather than absorbing it.

  • Ownership & Autonomy – You take initiative, move things forward, and deliver end to end without being chased.

  • Escalation Judgment – You escalate early, to the right person, with a proposal rather than a problem.

  • Client Confidence – You are comfortable running a meeting with a customer's finance or IT lead in it.

  • Four-Language Fluency – Technology, process, data and people. You speak each well enough to spot where a roadblock really sits.

  • Structured Under Pressure – When a project goes sideways you get sharper and more organized, not louder.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience delivering complex projects: management consulting, enterprise software implementation, or large-scale transformation delivery.

  • Proven track record running multi-country or multi-entity programs with senior client stakeholders, and steering a committee that includes client executives.

  • Experience leading a delivery team rather than only a plan.

  • Strong analytical and communication skills. You can translate a business need into something a technical team can act on.

  • Fluent in German and English, spoken and written.

  • Bonus points for ERP implementation experience, finance or supply chain processes, or AI-driven SaaS.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you shape your projects, outcomes, and career path.

  • Impact at scale – your work powers automation across global enterprises.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with engineers, data scientists, and business leaders daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Amazing team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Visits & offsites – paid visits and stays at our HQ in Zurich, including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about blp and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

Du kommst also nicht als einzelne Automatisierungskraft in eine Fachabteilung, sondern in eine Gruppe, die dasselbe Handwerk betreibt wie du.

Unsere Sales-Organisation umfasst aktuell 30 Personen und wächst schnell. Parallel entwickeln wir eine HubSpot-basierte CRM-Architektur, neue B2B-Strukturen und eine datengetriebene Marketing- und Sales Engine. Genau in diesem Umbau setzt deine Arbeit an.

  • Marketing und Sales

Kurz gesagt: Du baust an unserem internen Betriebssystem – und setzt selbst um, was du entworfen hast. Für reine Strategie- oder Analystenarbeit ist die Rolle nicht gedacht: Hier wird gebaut, eingeführt und gemessen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Process Intelligence & Automation: Du durchleuchtest Abläufe in Marketing, Sales, Operations und Akademie, bewertest sie nach Aufwand, Häufigkeit und wirtschaftlichem Hebel und automatisierst die Prozesse mit dem größten Effekt.
  • Internal Tools & Rapid Prototyping: Du baust mit KI- und No-Code-Werkzeugen (z. B. n8n, KI-Agenten) interne Anwendungen und Prototypen, testest sie direkt im laufenden Betrieb und übernimmst Rollout, Dokumentation und Einweisung der Teams.

  • Data, KPI & Reporting: Du führst Daten aus unseren Systemen zusammen, definierst Kennzahlen entlang der Growth Engine – von Leadgenerierung über Funnel bis Enrollment – und baust die Grundlagen für datenbasierte Entscheidungen im Management.
  • Build-vs-Buy & Tool Evaluation: Du bewertest neue Tools und Frameworks entlang von Kosten, Nutzen und Skalierbarkeit und gibst eine begründete Empfehlung: selbst bauen oder einkaufen.
  • Business Building Support: Du erarbeitest Datengrundlagen und Unit Economics für neue Geschäftsmodelle und Beteiligungen und lieferst damit die Basis für Go-/No-go-Entscheidungen.

Technologie ist dabei Mittel, nicht Ergebnis. Deine Arbeit soll uns mehr Anfragen bringen, die Abschlussquote erhöhen, Entscheidungswege verkürzen oder Wachstum ohne zusätzliche Verwaltung ermöglichen – messbar in Stunden, Kosten pro Vorgang und Durchlaufzeit.

Kein Informatikstudium nötig – zeig uns einfach etwas, das du gebaut hast: ein Automatisierungs-Flow, ein GPT, ein Dashboard, ein Nebenprojekt.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Sinnvolle Arbeit mit direktem Impact: Du arbeitest nicht an abstrakten Business Cases, sondern an Systemen, die echte Bildungschancen schneller erreichbar machen – mit direkter Wirkung auf Arbeitsmarktintegration und Fachkräftesicherung.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst tiefe Einblicke in den Aufbau einer skalierenden Organisation – von CRM-Architektur über datengetriebene Steuerung bis zu moderner Growth- und KI-Infrastruktur.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum & Verantwortung: Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in der Schublade. Du übernimmst früh Verantwortung und arbeitest direkt mit Entscheider:innen.
  • Hybrid & Flexibilität: Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Berliner Büro, mit klaren Strukturen, moderner digitaler Infrastruktur und einem Team, das auf Vertrauen, Ownership und Ergebnisse setzt.
  • Faire Vergütung & Perspektive: Leistungsbezogene Vergütung und bei überzeugender Leistung das Gespräch über eine Weiterbeschäftigung.
  • Teamspirit & Sparring: Fachliche Begleitung durch Kolleg:innen aus Infrastruktur, Data, Sales und Marketing, regelmäßiges Feedback und Zugang zu unseren eigenen Weiterbildungsangeboten.


Unser Bekenntnis zur Chancengleichheit

Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexueller Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen.   • Unsere 3D-Modelle verbessern: Du bringst Bilddaten und moderne 3D-Rekonstruktionsverfahren in das Produkt, von Multi-View Stereo bis zu Methoden wie Gaussian Splatting und verbesserst damit unsere Gebäudemodelle erheblich.

  • Mehr aus den Bildern herausholen: Du implementierst Methoden wie Multi-Image Super-Resolution und Occlusion-Aware Reconstruction. So überwindest du begrenzte Bildauflösung und Verdeckungen durch Bäume und andere Objekte.

  • AI-native entwickeln: Du nutzt das volle Potenzial moderner AI-Coding-Tools wie Claude Code und Copilot und identifizierst proaktiv neue KI-Use-Cases im Kontext von Computer Vision und 3D-Rekonstruktion.

title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine

About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

  • Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

  • Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

  • Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

  • Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

  • Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

  • Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics.

  • Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve.

  • Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance.

  • Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology.

  • Taken core quality metrics to best-in-class levels and kept them improving quarter over quarter.

  • Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Extensive product management experience (typically 8+ years) in search, discovery, ML, or NLP-heavy products, including time operating at a senior or staff level.

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery.

  • Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research.

  • Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

Benefits

  • Unlimited vacation time — we strongly encourage all of our employees to take at least 3 weeks per year.

  • A competitive compensation package including stock options.

  • Company-sponsored US health coverage (100% paid for employee).

  • Fully remote team — choose where you live.

  • Work-from-home stipend! We want you to have the resources you need to set up your home office.

  • Apple laptops provided for new employees.

  • Training and development budget for every employee, refreshed each year.

  • Parental leave for qualified employees.

  • Work with smart people who will help you grow and make a meaningful impact.

This position is fully remote — Constructor.io is a remote-first company.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Constructor

At Constructor.io we are committed to cultivating a work environment that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome individuals of all backgrounds and provide equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of their education, diversity of opinion, race, color, religion, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status or affiliation in any other protected group.

As a key member of Magnet Forensics’ EMEA team, you will operate with significant ownership of the EMEA FSP 2 region, working closely with partners located across Europe, marketing, dedicated sales development representative (SDR), sales engineering, and leadership to establish and scale market presence.

          • Deliver solution-led sales engagements aligned to customer outcomes and business value.

title: Staff Product Manager: Product Discovery Engine
description:
Staff Product Manager, Product Discovery Engine

About Us

Constructor powers product search and discovery for some of the largest retailers in the world. We serve billions of requests every week, and you’ve probably seen our results somewhere and used our product without knowing it. We differentiate ourselves by focusing on metrics over features, and reinventing search and discovery from the ground up as a machine learning challenge with the specific goal of improving metrics like revenue. We’re approximately doubling year over year despite the market slowing down and have customers in every eCommerce vertical. We’re a passionate team of technologists who love solving problems and want to make our customers’ and coworkers’ lives better. We value empathy, openness, curiosity, continuous improvement, and are excited by metrics that matter. We believe that empowering everyone in a company to do what they think is best can lead to great things.

Job Summary

We’re looking for a systems-minded Staff Product Manager to take Constructor’s search and discovery to the state of the art — and keep it there — across every retail industry we serve. This is a highly technical, high-leverage role at the core of our Product Discovery Engine chapter: the teams responsible for how we retrieve, understand, and rank the right products for every shopper, on every query, for every customer.

Your job is to raise discovery quality and, through it, our customers’ business metrics. You won’t be measured on features shipped — you’ll be measured on relevance and business outcomes, like conversion, revenue per visit, and search-attributed GMV, moving up.

You’ll start embedded with our Search Quality team, owning its strategy and roadmap and getting deep into the systems that decide what shoppers actually see. Over time, your mandate grows to setting direction for the entire Product Discovery Engine chapter — deciding where we’re heading and why across recall, ranking, query understanding, personalization, and the ML infrastructure underneath. This is a Staff role today with a clear path to Director as you take on chapter-wide leadership.

Search at Constructor is fundamentally a machine learning problem, so this role lives and breathes ML. You’ll partner closely with ML, data science, and engineering to turn the latest research into production wins, keep us ahead of both commercial competitors and academic state of the art, and be the connective tissue that aligns multiple teams — ML Recall, ML Infra, and, over time, teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management — behind a single, coherent vision for great discovery.

If you’re excited about driving innovation across dozens of the world’s largest retailers, being held to relevance and business outcomes, and pushing an already best-in-class product further ahead, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own business impact, not features. Drive measurable lift in search-attributed conversion, revenue per visit, and GMV alongside relevance across our customer base.

  • Deliver across every retail industry. Move quality and business metrics across all the verticals we serve, accounting for the differences in catalog, language, and shopper intent.

  • Keep us at the state of the art. Continuously translate the latest ML / IR research and competitive moves into production wins, and ship SOTA ML / LLM-assisted capabilities that beat our previous best on relevance.

  • Set chapter vision and strategy. Define the multi-quarter direction for the Product Discovery Engine — where we’re heading and why — tie it directly to customer business outcomes, and rally teams behind it.

  • Lead Search Quality first. Own its strategy and roadmap, driving measurable improvements in the relevance and correctness of results.

  • Orchestrate across the pipeline. Unify recall, ranking, query understanding, and personalization behind one definition of quality and one set of business metrics, so improvements compound instead of colliding.

  • Turn ML research into production wins. Partner deeply with ML and data science to take models — from candidate generation and recall to LLM-assisted interpretation — from idea to production, balancing accuracy, latency, and cost.

  • Make quality measurable and explainable. Build the metrics, evaluation frameworks, and tooling the whole chapter uses to measure, attribute, and explain discovery quality and its business impact.

  • Own quality under pressure. Lead investigation and triage when issues arise, and design durable, systemic fixes rather than one-off patches.

  • Grow the mandate. Expand into chapter-wide leadership spanning ML Recall, ML Infra, and — over time — teams like CORE, SABR, and Catalog Management.

What Success Looks Like

Within your first year, you will have:

  • Driven measurable lift in search-attributed conversion and revenue per visit — moving business metrics, not just quality metrics.

  • Driven measurable business-metric lift (conversion, revenue per visit, GMV) and relevance lift across every major retail vertical we serve.

  • Shipped at least one state-of-the-art ML / LLM-assisted capability into production that beats our previous best on relevance.

  • Won head-to-head quality benchmarks against every major competitor in the verticals we compete in, with a repeatable, defensible methodology.

  • Stood up an evaluation framework and tooling that ties model and system investments directly to customer business outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • A track record of moving business metrics at scale — conversion, revenue, engagement — not just shipping features, and of setting strategy across multiple teams.

  • Deep understanding of the end-to-end search pipeline: query interpretation → recall / candidate generation → ranking → reranking → personalization → delivery.

  • Strong ML product depth — owning production models and reasoning about tradeoffs between high-capacity (LLM / batch) and low-latency (real-time) approaches — and a habit of staying current with state-of-the-art research.

  • Fluency with retrieval and recall, query understanding (tokenization, synonyms, spelling correction, multilingual support), and search evaluation frameworks.

  • A rigorous, measurement-first mindset that ties every quality investment back to business outcomes.

  • Excellent cross-functional leadership — able to align teams with different goals behind a shared definition of quality and a shared set of business metrics, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, data science, and ML Ops.

  • Comfort operating with ambiguity, setting direction where none exists yet, and leading through clarity and credibility rather than the org chart.

The Inference Foundation team owns the core of Mistral's inference stack: the inference engine and its orchestration, from the feature set and configuration that serve our models in production to the release machinery that keeps the stack current and production-grade.

This is a hybrid position spanning production LLM serving, engine and platform development, and capacity engineering. You will work on three intertwined problems:

Inference engine & orchestration

  • Develop and fix the core of the inference stack — engine and orchestrator — including feature selection, configuration, and tuning for maximum performance at scale

Performance & capacity at scale

  • Optimize serving efficiency across the fleet — driving down pod startup time, tackling cold-cache regressions on scale-up, smarter caching and offloading

  • Optimize and maintain the optimal serving topology — overlap communication and transfers with computation, ensure optimal placement, connectivity, and routing

Serving for frontier training

  • Build the serving infrastructure that powers RL and post-training for our frontier models

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and running ML/LLM services at scale, with clear latency and availability targets

  • Hands-on experience with inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or others

description:
Über Hyca Heat

Hyca Heat ist ein deutsches Deep-Tech-Startup an der Spitze der industriellen Energiewende. Wir entwickeln eine weltweit einzigartige, patentierte Heiztechnologie, die hocheffiziente katalytische Verbrennung mit elektrischer Beheizung kombiniert, und dekarbonisieren damit die Prozesswärmeindustrie. Unser Team aus erfahrenen Ingenieuren, Unternehmern und Wissenschaftlern arbeitet in Jülich an einer der größten Herausforderungen unserer Zeit.

Deine Mission

Wir suchen eine:n erfahrene:n Ingenieur:in für die Auslegung und Entwicklung elektrischer Hochtemperatur-Heizsysteme (w/m/d) für unser Team in Jülich. Hybrid-Position mit in der Regel 1–2 Homeoffice-Tagen pro Woche.

Du verantwortest das Herzstück unserer Anlagen: die elektrische Widerstandsheizung unserer Prozessgaserhitzer. Die Besonderheit unserer Technologie: Der Heizleiter ist zugleich die Trägerstruktur des Katalysators – elektrische Beheizung, Wärmeübertragung und katalytische Verbrennung finden in einem einzigen Bauteil statt. Geometrie, Werkstoff, Temperaturprofil und Beschichtung lassen sich nicht unabhängig voneinander optimieren. Genau das macht die Aufgabe anspruchsvoll.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Auslegung elektrischer Widerstandsheizer und Prozessgaserhitzer: Oberflächenbelastung, Heizleitertemperatur, Widerstands- und Leistungsauslegung sowie Wärmeübergang in gasdurchströmten Systemen.
  • Werkstoffauswahl unter realen Atmosphären: FeCrAl und NiCr/Nickelbasis gegen die tatsächliche Gaszusammensetzung – Oxidation, Aufkohlung, Nitrierung, Schwefel- und Wasserdampfeinfluss.
  • Auslegung der Heizleiterstruktur als Katalysatorträger: Zusammenspiel von Geometrie, Oberfläche und Temperaturprofil mit der katalytischen Beschichtung – Beschichtbarkeit, Schichthaftung und Alterung.
  • Thermomechanik und konstruktive Integration: Wärmedehnung und Dehnungsausgleich, Kriechen, Zyklenfestigkeit, Strömungsführung und Vermeidung von Hot-Spots.
  • Erprobung und Systemtests: Prüfstände, Messungen und Schadensanalysen – auch bei Inbetriebnahme und Abnahme beim Kunden – sowie die Auslegungstools und Spezifikationen, mit denen wir künftige Systeme entwickeln.
  • Weiterentwicklung vom Prototyp bis zur Serienfertigung, inklusive Auswahl und Steuerung von Lieferanten.

Was du unbedingt mitbringen solltest

  • Studium oder Technikerausbildung (Bachelor/Master oder Techniker) in Maschinenbau, Verfahrenstechnik, Energietechnik, Werkstofftechnik, Elektrotechnik oder einem verwandten Feld.
  • Industrieerfahrung mit elektrischer Widerstandsheizung: mehrjährige Erfahrung in Auslegung, Entwicklung oder Konstruktion elektrischer Heizsysteme – etwa bei einem Heizleiter- oder Heizelementhersteller, im elektrischen Erhitzerbau oder im Industrieofen- und Thermoprozessanlagenbau.
  • Erfahrung mit Heizleiterstrukturen: Drähte, Bänder, Metallfolien, Netze, Gestruk oder Schäume – du weißt, wie die Bauform auf Oberflächenbelastung, Strömung, Druckverlust und Standzeit durchschlägt. Bei uns trägt genau diese Struktur zusätzlich die katalytische Beschichtung.
  • Werkstoff- und thermomechanisches Verständnis: Du weißt, wie Prozessgase Heizleiterwerkstoffe angreifen, und behandelst Wärmedehnung, thermische Spannungen, Kriechen und Zyklenbelastung als Auslegungsgrößen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch (C1/C2) und sehr gutes Englisch.
  • Offenheit für die Integration und Nutzung von KI-Tools.

Was uns zusätzlich begeistert

  • Erfahrung als Projektleiter:in oder in der Inbetriebnahme beim Kunden.
  • Berufserfahrung mit Brenner-/Heizsystemen, katalytischen Beschichtungen (Washcoat), Wabenkörpern oder metallischen Katalysatorträgern.
  • Kenntnisse in MSR-Technik und Leistungsstellung (Thyristorsteller, Phasenanschnitt, Schwingungspaket).
  • Simulation und Berechnung: FEM/CFD, CAD sowie Python oder MATLAB für Auslegungsrechnungen und Messdatenauswertung.
  • Erfahrung mit Hochtemperaturkorrosion oder mit Schadensanalysen an thermisch belasteten Bauteilen.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Einzigartige Herausforderung: Deep-Tech-Hardware an der Schnittstelle von Energietechnik, Werkstoffkunde und Katalyse.
  • Verantwortung und Wachstum: Übernimm vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung und wachse mit dem Unternehmen.

title: Senior SAP functional in-house Consultant (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for an experienced SAP functional Consultant (m/f/d) to join our ERP Finance team at Flix, in Berlin or Munich. 

In the Foundation Division of FlixTech, the ERP Finance team is responsible for the platform that powers our financial backbone: accounting, controlling, procurement, period close, and the integrations that connect them to the rest of Flix. We're setting up a new ERP system for our Train business (FlixTrain) with a first focus on Finance and Procurement. 

As our in-house SAP expert, you'll work closely with our Finance and Procurement teams as well as external partners to make sure the new ERP fits our needs: today and in the long run. After go-live, you'll be the person who owns, evolves and continuously improves the SAP solution from the inside. 

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys ownership, working close to real business problems, and combining solid SAP craftsmanship with a long-term, in-house perspective 

About the Role

  • Act as Flix's in-house SAP expert during the implementation of our new ERP, with a focus on Finance and Procurement. 
  • Translate business requirements from Finance, Procurement and adjacent functions into clean, scalable SAP solutions. 
  • Work closely with external implementation partners during design, build, testing and cut over. 
  • Support data migration, test management, and go-live preparation from a Flix-side ownership perspective. 
  • Take long-term ownership of the SAP solution after go-live: enhancements, change requests, integrations and continuous process improvement. 
  • Contribute to building broader SAP capability within the ERP Finance team thought teaching and mentoring. 
  • Be a trusted advisor to Finance and Procurement stakeholders on what SAP can do for 

About You

  • 7+ years of experience as an SAP Consultant (incl. 5+ years in S/4HANA), with a strong focus on Finance (FI/CO) and Procurement (MM). 
  • Additional working knowledge in SAP Supply Chain and Asset Management modules. 
  • At least two full end-to-end SAP implementations, ideally in a company of similar size and complexity to Flix. 
  • Solid understanding of core finance and procurement processes: General Ledger, Accounts Payable / Receivable, Fixed Assets, Controlling, Purchase-to-Pay. 
  • Experience working with external system integrators and the confidence to engage with them as an equal partner. 
  • Comfortable engaging with senior Finance and Procurement stakeholders and translating between business and SAP language. 
  • Structured, pragmatic, delivery-oriented; strong communication and facilitation skills. 
  • Based in Germany, you're fluent in German and English. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Senior Data Scientist, Workforce Management Analytics
description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Support Group

As the name Support Group implies, this group is responsible for the core part of the customer experience journey that has got Wolt top-notch ratings in app stores. 

During the years we've invested a lot in the in-house built support tooling as we believe that it's the only way we can ensure the satisfaction of all of our customers and partners in each of the 25 countries that we operate in. We take huge pride in our customer operations' quality, so on top of building delightful support experiences in our consumer app we also want to proactively identify and solve issues even before our customers and partners even notice something might be wrong.

About the Support Analytics Team

Our Support Analytics team's main goal is to deliver an amazing Customer, Merchants & Courier support experience while optimizing our operations by providing actionable insights and quantifying the impact of those actions on the overall business. 💡 

You'll be part of this team working with top Data Science and Analytics Engineering professionals.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Data Scientist at Wolt, your role involves diving into our data to solve crucial business problems. The scope of this role ranges from diagnosing problem areas to identifying solutions to designing experiments and ultimately influencing decision-making. This is a rare, operational, and actionable data-driven experience. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.

Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the Workforce Management (WFM) team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.

Our humble expectations

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in a data science or analytics position
  • Experience building forecasting models and time series analysis (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)
  • Experience in Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis
  • Deep knowledge of statistical packages in Python or R
  • Proficiency in writing structured and efficient SQL queries for large data sets
  • Ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders Good to have:
  • Experience using ML for forecasting
  • Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform
  • Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools

What we offer

  • The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.
  • You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in Berlin. 💙 
  • You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don't learn, we won't stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda's greatest achievement.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via  

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

description:

FACT-Finder entwickelt Product-Discovery-Technologie für den eCommerce und ist mit den Produkten Next Generation und Infinity bei führenden Online-Shops in Europa im Einsatz.   • Du führst und entwickelst unser derzeit 4-köpfiges Hosting-Team fachlich und disziplinarisch, verantwortest Performance und prägst die technische Standards- und Ownership-Kultur.
  • Du machst AI zum festen Bestandteil unserer Operations: Diagnose, Automatisierung, Monitoring und Insight.

Dein Profil

  • Fundierter Hintergrund in Infrastructure oder Platform Engineering über On-Premise und Cloud hinweg.
  • Hands-on Tiefe mit Kubernetes in Produktion: Cluster-Lifecycle, Upgrades, Networking, Storage, RBAC, Observability, GitOps-Delivery.
  • Nachweislich starke Führungserfahrung, exzellente Kommunikation und Stakeholder-Management.
  • Idealerweise praktische Erfahrung mit Harvester oder vergleichbaren HCI-/Virtualisierungsplattformen (KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack).

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kubernetes Operators (Custom Controllers / CRDs), idealerweise für stateful Systeme wie Search, Datenbanken oder Streaming.
  • Solides Verständnis von Auto-Scaling-Primitiven (HPA, VPA, Cluster Autoscaler, KEDA) und deren Zusammenspiel mit Kapazitätsplanung.
  • Erfahrung mit On-Prem-Hybrid-Architekturen und der Verantwortung für Reliability, Kapazität und Kosten produktiver Systeme.
  • Hands-on Fluency im Einsatz von AI-Tools im operativen Betrieb.
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse; Deutsch von Vorteil.

THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US

  • Impact from day one: Deine Arbeit wirkt direkt auf die Umsätze führender eCommerce-Marken in Europa.

  • du KI spannend findest, sie aber nicht aktiv in deinen Arbeitsalltag integrierst

  • Journalistische PR statt Massenversand: Bei uns gibt es keine generischen Pressemitteilungen oder Gießkannenverteiler. Wir arbeiten individuell, redaktionell und mit klarer Themenstrategie und pitchen gezielt per Telefon bei passenden Journalist*innen aus einem breiten Medienspektrum.

  • Flexibilität, die wirklich gelebt wird: Ob remote (innerhalb Deutschlands), hybrid oder im Berliner Office – wir ermöglichen Arbeitsmodelle, die sich mit deinem privaten und beruflichen Leben gut vereinbaren lassen. Deine Mission

Das Produkt steht. Jetzt entscheidet sich, wie wir darüber sprechen.

Das ist kein Callcenter-Job. Keine Kaltakquise, keine gekaufte Liste, keine Quote pro Stunde.
Du kontaktierst Betriebe, die uns bereits kennen. Installationspartner, mit denen wir seit Monaten oder Jahren arbeiten. Sie wissen, wer Bees & Bears ist — sie wissen nur noch nicht, was wir gerade Neues für sie gebaut haben.

Warum es diese Stelle gibt: Wir bringen ein neues Produkt an den Start, das unseren Partnerbetrieben einen konkreten Engpass löst. Technisch ist es fertig. Was jetzt zählt, ist die Einführung — und die passiert nicht über eine Mail. Sie passiert in Gesprächen.

Deine Aufgabe: Diese Gespräche führen. Du bekommst eine Einarbeitung und einen Gesprächsleitfaden. Nach acht Wochen sollte auch dieser Leitfaden noch besser sein, weil du hundert Gespräche geführt hast. Wer nur die Liste abarbeiten will, ist hier falsch. Wer wartet, bis jemand den nächsten Schritt vorgibt, auch.

Wohin die Rolle wächst: Sie startet fokussiert: ein Produkt, ein definierter Partnerkreis, ein Gespräch nach dem anderen. Sie ist aber nicht als Telefonjob angelegt, sondern als Einstieg ins Partner Management — eigene Partner, Ende zu Ende, von Erstkontakt bis laufender Betreuung.   • DU BRINGST WAS ZURÜCK: Nach fünfzig Gesprächen hast du eine Meinung dazu, was funktioniert. Du sagst sie, ohne dass wir danach fragen müssen.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Dinge baut und ins Ziel bringt, anstatt nur Entscheidungsvorlagen zu erarbeiten.

Deine Verantwortung

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und eng mit dem Management Team an strategisch relevanten Initiativen. Deine Themen sind keine Side Projects. Sie bewegen relevante Line-Items in unserem Business Plan.

Je nach Projekt bedeutet das:

  • neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren, auf Machbarkeit prüfen und umsetzen

  • komplexe, unstrukturierte Probleme in klare Hypothesen, Entscheidungen und Workstreams übersetzen

  • externe Partner:innen identifizieren, bewerten und kommerzielle Konditionen verhandeln

Du bewertest, welche Rolle Zasta darin spielen sollte – von einer Affiliate-Partnerschaft bis zu einer tief integrierten Produktlösung.

Markt & Strategie → Business Case → Partner Sourcing → Verhandlung → MVP → Tech-Integration → Go-live

Wir wollen beispielsweise testen, ob sich Out-of-Home zu einem skalierbaren Performance-Marketing-Kanal für Zasta entwickeln kann (und ja: Wir meinen Performance, nicht nur Brand).

Weitere Projekte können neue Partnerschaften, Pricing, regulatorische Themen, operative Skalierung, M&A, neue Produkte, Vertriebskanäle, vollständig neue Geschäftsmodelle oder interne Strukturen betreffen.

Wir suchen eine außergewöhnlich starke Kombination aus analytischer Exzellenz, Geschwindigkeit und Ownership.

  • einen sehr guten akademischen Track Record und einen sehr guten Abschluss von einer führenden Universität

Wenn du ein Problem siehst, wartest du nicht auf Zuständigkeiten. Du übernimmst Ownership, schaffst Klarheit und bringst die Lösung ins Ziel.

Exzellentes Deutsch ist zwingend erforderlich

title: Internship - Studio Apelbaum - Art, Engineering or Communication (Berlin)
description:
We are looking for interns in art, engineering, and communication to join Studio Apelbaum.

Studio Apelbaum, founded by artist and engineer Jonathan Apelbaum, combines traditional oil painting with interactive technology to create ‘Cognitive Paintings’ that shift images with light, movement, and sound through custom LED systems and software.

Our team includes engineers, musicians, performers, writers, designers, and builders. We are currently building a new 150 m² studio at Osloer Straße 16–17 in the historic Umspannwerk Christiania, with a workshop and our own exhibition space.

Our own series of invitation-only events and exhibitions is central to the new studio. Over the next few months, we will design and build adaptable furniture in steel and oak so the same room can host work, an exhibition, dinner, and an event.

The whole team is artists in their own way; they think differently and create their own methods.

We create the artworks, design the space, invite our guests, and welcome them. C’est le principe de l’œuvre complète / architecture verticale.

How the internship works

The internship is hands-on and involves working closely with the team across the studio: building, production, and exhibitions.

The first part of the internship will focus on building the new studio, including steel and oak furniture and the adaptable exhibition and dining space. You will then develop the Cognitive Paintings and assemble and test the paintings and their LED systems.

Over the six months, you will take on a main project based on your skills and interests, guided by the team. This could include engineering, programming, communication, music, design, documentation, filming, or any related field.

During the internship, you will gradually develop your own main project based on your skills and interests, in collaboration with Jonathan. This project can develop further and become one of your main areas of work within the studio.

You will also help prepare our major exhibition in May 2027, as well as installations and projects outside the studio with TRACEY (formerly Lunchbox Candy), Playground Festival, and other art festivals.

Tasks

Your tasks will include:

  • Co-building the new studio (steel and oak, as used in the paintings)
  • Co-building, assembling, and testing Cognitive Paintings and their LED systems
  • Organizing materials, tools, storage, artwork transport, and installations
  • Supporting the preparation and installation of exhibitions and events

Depending on your background, skills, and interests, whether in engineering, communication, curation, music, or another field, you will have the opportunity to develop a project that connects with your own passion.

This could include:

  • Contributing to research, prototypes, and software
  • Filming and documenting the studio
  • Designing the exhibition flyers, invitations, and catalog
  • Developing sound or music for exhibitions and events
  • Co-curating exhibitions
  • Exploring new frames, shapes, and materials for the paintings

Requirements

  • A strong interest in art, design, engineering, and communication
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a chosen family
  • Interest in working across different disciplines
  • Reliability, flexibility, and willingness to take initiative
  • A valid driving license is a plus, particularly for assisting with transport, installations, and external projects

Benefits

The internship is part-time, six months, and unpaid.

You don't need a specific background or all the skills listed. You will work closely with a diverse team and learn how to work with electronics, steel, and oak, as well as production and exhibition installation. You will also help prepare and install our main exhibition in May 2027.

Our studio is a place to teach, learn, and grow together. The main project you develop during the internship will be shaped around your own skills and interests and can become the direction of your future work in the studio. We are looking for people who are interested in long-term collaborations.

Please send:

  • CV
  • A portfolio, if available
  • A motivation letter explaining your interest in the studio and the direction you would like to take

title: Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d)
description:
FlixTrain ist die Challenger-Marke im deutschen Fernverkehr: grün, mutig und anders als der Platzhirsch. Auf Social Media wollen wir genau das zeigen, nicht als Kanäle, die „auch noch mitlaufen", sondern als eigenständige Bühne, auf der unsere Marke für digital-first Zielgruppen erlebbar wird. 

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Social Media Manager (m/w/d), der Organic Social bei FlixTrain weiterdenkt. Einige Kanäle laufen schon, aber ohne eigene Handschrift. Genau da kommst du ins Spiel: Du machst aus mitlaufenden Kanälen eine eigenständige FlixTrain-Präsenz. Du bekommst einen Startpunkt mit Reichweite, aber freie Hand beim Aufbau von Strategie, Struktur, Prozessen und Partner-Setup. Du entscheidest, wo wir spielen und wo nicht, übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformgerecht und machst Wirkung messbar. Die Rolle ist Teil des Brand Teams und bewusst als eigenverantwortliche Aufbaurolle angelegt: Du bist In-House-Kopf und Taktgeber, die Produktion steuerst du über Agentur, Creator und internes Creative Team. 

Entscheidend ist eine Haltung: Nähe zum Zeitgeist, ohne jedem Trend hinterherzulaufen. Wir wollen Reichweite mit Substanz: Content, der zur Marke passt, nicht bloße Content-Masse. 

Über die Rolle 

Strategie & Where-to-play 

  • Du entwickelst die Organic-Social-Strategie für FlixTrain: klare Ziele, Zielgruppen und Kommunikations-Säulen: abgeleitet aus der übergeordneten Markenstrategie, nicht als Insel. 
  • Du triffst die Where-to-play-Entscheidung: Du prüfst die bestehenden Kanäle, entscheidest, welche wir fokussieren und welche bewusst nicht, und identifizierst, wo FlixTrain zusätzlich präsent sein sollte. 
  • Du definierst das Zusammenspiel aus „Big Moment"-Ideen (große, reichweitenstarke Momente, die kulturelle Relevanz schaffen) und Ongoing-Community-Content (kontinuierlich, näher an der bestehenden Community)  

Markenübersetzung & Content 

  • Du übersetzt die FlixTrain-Marke plattformnativ – nicht als adaptierten Kampagnen-Cutdown, sondern als eigenständige, kanaltypische Formate, die organisch wirken statt „gebrandet". 
  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Content zum Zeitgeist UND zur Marke passt: Du kombinierst Entertainment- und Kultur-Trends mit echtem Markenfit – kein Trend-Hopping, kein „AI-Slop", kein Content um des Contents willen. 
  • Du betreibst Community Management, hältst die Marke im Dialog präsent und behältst auch bei kritischen Themen einen souveränen Ton – mit dem Gespür, wann ein Fall an PR gehört. 

Partner- & Produktions-Setup 

  • Du baust das richtige Partner-Setup auf und steuerst es. Darüber hinaus managst du das Budget eigenverantwortlich und entscheidest, welche Inhalte gezielt verstärkt werden. 

Measurement & Wirkung 

  • Du machst die Wirkung von Organic Social mit den richtigen KPIs je Zielstellung und Maßnahme messbar — von Big-Moment Content bis hin zu Ongoing-Content — und etablierst ein durchdachtes Reporting, aus dem du gezielt Learnings für die nächste Planungsrunde ableitest. 

Stakeholder & Schnittstellen 

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Brand Team, dem FlixBus Social Media Team und dem Creative Team zusammen und sorgst für strategische Konsistenz zwischen Organic, Paid und Kampagne. 
  • Du bist Sparringspartner für interne Stakeholder und externe Partner und vertrittst Social souverän gegenüber Management und Fachbereichen. 

Über Dich 

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Organic-Social- bzw. Content-Marketing – idealerweise mit Erfahrung auf Unternehmens- und Agenturseite. 
  • Du bist Generalist: Du denkst strategisch (Where-to-play, KPIs, Positionierung) und bleibst gleichzeitig hands-on in Redaktionsplanung, Briefing und Steuerung. 
  • Du hast Social-Strukturen oder -Kanäle aufgebaut oder maßgeblich geprägt, nicht nur verwaltet – du bringst Ownership und Aufbau-Mentalität mit. 
  • Du bist nah am Zeitgeist und kannst Entertainment-/Kultur-Trends lesen – aber mit dem Urteilsvermögen, sie am Markenfit zu messen und auch Nein zu sagen. 
  • Du steuerst Agenturen, Creator und Freelancer sicher und behältst Budget, Timings und Qualität im Blick. 
  • Du nutzt KPIs, Social Listening und Insights selbstverständlich als Grundlage von Entscheidungen – und erkennst den Unterschied zwischen Reichweite und Wirkung. 
  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch (jeweils mind. C1-Niveau). 

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze – auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, hier etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. 

Was Wir Bieten 

  • Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie. 
  • Arbeiten von überall: Je nach Rolle bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus. 
  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Bürokultur mit Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen. 
  • Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Maßnahmen zur Stressbewältigung – für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige. 
  • Lernen & Entwicklung: Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen. 
  • Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen. 

 

Warum Teil von Flix werden? 

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und preiswert zu gestalten – sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, sich einzubringen und die Art und Weise, wie wir arbeiten, mitzugestalten. 

Wenn du einen Job suchst, in dem du wachsen und etwas bewirken kannst, dann bist du bei FlixTrain genau richtig. Hier kannst du Teil eines Teams werden, in dem dein Beitrag zählt und du deine Reise selbst gestalten kannst!

title: Senior Talent Partner
description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

  • Acts as each hiring manager's partner on a search, not an order-taker: shaping the brief, setting the bar together, and holding the process to it

ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are succeeding if:

  • Hiring managers across engineering and non-engineering teams get strong shortlists when they need them, not a quarter later.

  • Regardless of source, the candidates are some of the best talent around, rather than people who happened to apply - and you can recognise the difference.

  • Every search you run has a clear brief, a consistent structured process, and no candidate waiting more than 3 days to hear from us.

  • The people you hire are still here and doing well a year on. We scaled sustainably, not just quickly.

  • A talent community exists around WunderGraph that didn't before: people who know us, follow what we do, and raise their hand when the right role opens.

  • Candidates keep telling us ours is the best hiring process they've been through, including the ones we don't hire. You keep it that way as we hire more.

  • Hiring managers trust your judgement enough to change their minds when you push back on a brief, and leadership trusts the plan because your hiring metrics are clear.

  • Our hiring processes are better because you changed them, not just because you ran them.

ROLE TASKS

The role focuses on, but is not limited to:

Full-cycle recruiting

  • Running multiple searches at once across engineering and non-engineering teams, from intake to accepted offer, prioritised by urgency

  • Running role kickoffs with hiring managers to agree outcomes, competencies and the interview loop

  • Writing job profiles and adverts with the People team, tailored to each audience

  • Pre-screening candidates and sharing shortlists with a clear recommendation

  • Coordinating interviews and running debriefs, with blind scorecards in Ashby before any group discussion

  • Keeping every candidate updated, with no one waiting more than 3 days to hear from us

  • Managing offers and closing candidates honestly, without pressure, ensuring each conversation with the candidates is meaningful and insightful for both us and the candidate.

Sourcing

  • Finding and engaging people who aren't looking, through sourcing, open-source projects, communities, meetups and conferences

  • Headhunting directly for senior and hard-to-fill roles

  • Writing outreach specific enough to each person that they actually reply

  • Keeping warm pipelines for roles we hire repeatedly

Stakeholders and reporting

  • Advising hiring managers on market realities: who's available, what they expect, and what that means for the brief

  • Keeping leadership updated with clear hiring metrics and progress

  • Escalating blockers early, with a proposed fix

Talent community and employer marketing

  • Building a community of people who know WunderGraph before they ever see a job post

  • Running creative, low-budget activity: events, content, community-led hiring, the odd meme that lands

  • Working out what worked, and dropping what didn't

Hiring process

  • Improving our interview loops, tasks and scorecards, including for technical roles

  • Documenting our recruitment workflows so they don't live in one person's head

  • Keeping hiring compliant across the countries we hire in, and handling contracts, background checks and documentation with the People team where needed

  • Keeping our hiring data and Ashby setup useful for planning, not just record-keeping23w

ROLE REQUIREMENTS

  • You've run full-cycle recruiting for both technical and non-technical roles, and can walk through searches you owned from brief to accepted offer.

  • You're a strong sourcer. You find people who aren't looking, and your outreach gets replies because it's written for the person reading it.

  • You tell a company's story in a way that makes the right candidates lean in: honest, specific, never a hard sell.

  • You keep several very different searches moving at once without letting candidate experience slip.

  • You work independently and keep things moving when the path isn't clear, without waiting to be told what to do.

  • You're based in Europe or the UK and can regularly overlap with US hours. For CET or EEST, that means some later evenings.

Bonus points

  • You've built or redesigned a technical hiring process (the loop, the task, the scorecard), not just run one.

  • You've built a talent community or run creative employer marketing that led to real hires.

  • You've hired in, or for stakeholders in, the US market.

  • You've handled hiring compliance, contracts or background checks across more than one European country.

Why WunderGraph?

  • Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.

  • Pick your preferred work hardware

  • We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

  • You can make a real difference and find lots of opportunities to grow together with us

  • Discretionary PTO: take the time you need to recharge

  • Competitive compensation

  • Depending on location, we offer healthcare benefits according to local standards

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.

The Process

We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

  • 45 min discussion with the hiring manager. Following this, you might receive a small take home assignment related to the role. This is your chance to prove your skill!

  • Complete the assignment and review together with hiring manager

Our process also includes reference and background checks. We aim to respond or provide feedback in 2 or 3 days between each stage of the process. We're usually hiring through Deel as our Employer of Record, except for Germany or Florida where we're hiring directly.

WunderGraph is an equal opportunity workplace; we welcome people from all backgrounds.

WunderGraph Public Handbook and Resources
