title: Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt.
description:
Kfz-Meister gesucht – vielleicht ist es Zeit für eine Werkstatt, die wirklich zu dir passt.

Wir sind autoteam augsburg, eine inhabergeführte Kfz-Meisterwerkstatt in Augsburg-Kriegshaber.

Bei uns geht es nicht darum, möglichst viele Fahrzeuge irgendwie durch die Werkstatt zu bekommen. Uns ist wichtig, dass sauber gearbeitet wird, Probleme wirklich gelöst werden und unsere Kunden ihr Fahrzeug mit einem guten Gefühl wieder abholen.

Wir arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken und decken ein breites Spektrum ab: Inspektionen nach Herstellervorgaben, Diagnose, Bremsen, Motor, Fahrwerk, Klima, Getriebe, Umbauten und vieles mehr. Gerade deshalb ist der Alltag bei uns abwechslungsreich. Kein Tag ist genau wie der andere und wenn ein Fehler nicht sofort auf der Hand liegt, nehmen wir uns die Zeit, ihn wirklich zu finden.

Unsere Werkstatt ist modern und sehr gut ausgestattet. Mehrere Hebebühnen, aktuelle Diagnosetechnik und alles, was man braucht, um ordentlich arbeiten zu können. Gleichzeitig legen wir viel Wert darauf, dass die Werkstatt sauber, gepflegt und ein angenehmer Arbeitsplatz ist. Schließlich verbringt man hier einen großen Teil seines Tages und soll sich auch wohlfühlen.

Für unser Team suchen wir einen Kfz-Meister (m/w/d), der sein Handwerk versteht, gerne Verantwortung übernimmt und Lust auf ein Umfeld hat, in dem gute Arbeit geschätzt wird.

Was wir dir bieten

Bei uns kannst du dein Wissen und deine Erfahrung wirklich einbringen. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Entscheidungen mitzutreffen und bei anspruchsvolleren Fällen deine Erfahrung einzusetzen.

Du unterstützt unser Team bei Diagnose und Fehlersuche, behältst die Qualität der Arbeiten im Blick und sorgst gemeinsam mit uns dafür, dass die Abläufe in der Werkstatt stimmen. Wenn du gerne selbst mit am Fahrzeug arbeitest, Fehler suchst und technische Lösungen findest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes Unternehmen. Das bedeutet bei uns: kurze Wege, direkte Gespräche und schnelle Entscheidungen. Keine Konzernstrukturen, keine unnötigen Umwege und kein Gefühl, nur irgendeine Personalnummer zu sein.

Was wir dir außerdem bieten:

  • einen sicheren und langfristigen Arbeitsplatz

  • eine moderne, saubere und sehr gut ausgestattete Werkstatt

  • abwechslungsreiche Arbeiten an Fahrzeugen aller Marken

  • viel Eigenverantwortung und Vertrauen

  • kurze Entscheidungswege

  • ein angenehmes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld

  • eine faire und leistungsgerechte Vergütung

  • Möglichkeiten zur Weiterbildung

  • einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem gute Arbeit gesehen und geschätzt wird

Uns ist wichtig, dass man gerne zur Arbeit kommt, vernünftig miteinander umgeht, sich gegenseitig unterstützt und sich aufeinander verlassen kann. Denn am Ende verbringen wir einen großen Teil unseres Tages miteinander und da sollte nicht nur die Arbeit passen, sondern auch das Miteinander.

Was du mitbringst

Voraussetzung für die Stelle ist ein abgeschlossener Kfz-Meistertitel.

Du kennst den Werkstattalltag, kannst selbstständig arbeiten und übernimmst Verantwortung, wenn es darauf ankommt. Bei schwierigeren Diagnosen oder Fehlerbildern gibst du nicht sofort auf, sondern möchtest verstehen, wo das Problem liegt und wie man es vernünftig löst.

Außerdem wünschen wir uns jemanden, der:

  • sauber und zuverlässig arbeitet

  • einen hohen Anspruch an die eigene Arbeit hat

  • freundlich und respektvoll mit Kunden und Kollegen umgeht

  • sein Fachwissen gerne ins Team einbringt

  • Entscheidungen treffen kann

  • Verantwortung übernimmt

  • und vor allem noch Freude am Kfz-Handwerk hat

Natürlich muss am Ende auch das Menschliche stimmen.

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf. Wir suchen einen guten Meister, der zu uns und zu unserem Team passt.

Wenn du momentan in einer Werkstatt arbeitest und dir schon länger denkst, dass eine Veränderung vielleicht genau das Richtige wäre, dann melde dich einfach bei uns.

Du musst dafür keinen komplizierten Bewerbungsprozess durchlaufen. Komm vorbei, schau dir unsere Werkstatt an und lern uns kennen. Dann sehen wir ganz in Ruhe, ob es für beide Seiten passt.

description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

Heidi sits in an unusual position. We lead a category being built for the first time. Hundreds of thousands of clinicians found us on their own, started using the product for free and told a colleague. The market is open and the clinicians in it already like the product. Your job is to turn those smaller scale use cases into enterprise deals.

You're the first line to Heidi in DACH. Inbound demand connects you with practices, MVZs and hospital groups already using us, and you decide whether to qualify each one in, out or close it yourself. Where the signals run thin, you build the outbound.

For most clinicians you'll be the first person from Heidi they ever speak to. You'll both triage inbound to your Account Executive where it belongs and close your own deals from day one, because we want people as close to the frontline as possible. You'll build a network across German-speaking healthcare that outlasts the role.

What you’ll do

  • Work the inbound queue and the warm product signals across DACH. Your day goes to clinicians and practices already using Heidi, where the product tells you who's outgrown the free version.

  • Build outbound where the signals are thin: pick the practice groups, MVZs and hospital groups worth going after and work them in German.

  • Research the accounts behind those signals, work out who else in the practice or hospital group needs to be in the conversation, and build the angle for each one.

  • Reach the people the signals point to, across calls, email and social, while the interest is still fresh.

  • Book demos and meetings for your AEs with enough context that nothing is lost in the handoff.

  • Own small SMB deals end to end, from first conversation through to closed.

  • Keep HubSpot accurate, keep the pipeline moving and hit your qualified-lead number every month.

  • Partner with AEs, Marketing, Product, Operations and Customer Success so what you promise on the call matches what clinicians get, and so the German-language product and collateral keep up with what you hear.

  • Track what's shifting in German healthcare (regulation, the practice groups, the insurers, the competitive set) and tell the team what you're hearing on the phones.

What we're looking for

  • Native or fluent German, and English that allows you to work in a global team.

  • You've worked somewhere with a high bar, whether that's tech, sales, creative, banking, consulting, or PE/VC. We care more about what you've achieved than any time in a sales role.

  • You care about what we do. You'd rather learn how the product works than memorise a pitch.

  • You can hold a conversation with anyone and get to the point of it fast. Clinicians have extremely busy schedules, you respect that and still get the meeting.

  • Knowing how German healthcare buys (who decides in a Praxis, an MVZ or a hospital group, and who pays) is a head start. If you don't know it yet, you're the type who'd learn it in your first month.

  • Organised and self-running. You run your own list, your own day and your own follow-ups without being chased.

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping or side projects.

  • You default to building over requesting.

  • You're confident in your thinking and open to being wrong. Great ideas win regardless of who surfaces them.

 

Attitude is more important than experience so if you are a hungry, competitive and highly motivated operator who has a knack for problem solving and building relationships we want to hear from you.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Bei uns erwarten dich Verantwortung, Tempo und echter Gestaltungsspielraum – verbunden mit der Erwartung, dass du ihn nutzt.  Mit unseren Produkten bringen wir die Energie von morgen direkt zu den Menschen nach Hause. Unsere Mission ist es, nachhaltige Energie einfach, zugänglich und alltagstauglich zu machen. 


Du sorgst dafür, dass die richtige Botschaft zur richtigen Zeit bei den richtigen Kund:innen ankommt und machst sichtbar, welchen Beitrag CRM zu unserem Wachstum leistet.

Als unser:e neue:r


Senior CRM Manager:in /  Lifecycle & Retention

entwickelst du CRM bei uns von einem bislang nebenbei betriebenen Kanal zu einer echten Wachstumsfunktion. Die Basis ist da: Klaviyo, mehrere hunderttausend Leads und Kund:innen sowie jede Menge Daten. Was fehlt, ist eine klare CRM-Strategie mit intelligenter Segmentierung, automatisierten Lifecycle-Flows, strukturiertem Testing und einem Reporting, das Wirkung und Umsatzbeitrag sichtbar macht.

Du verschickst bei uns also nicht einfach Newsletter. Du gestaltest, wie wir entlang des gesamten Lifecycles Kund:innen ansprechen und langfristig binden. Dafür bekommst du echte Ownership, viel Gestaltungsspielraum und die Chance, CRM bei Kleines Kraftwerk von Grund auf zu prägen.

Bereit, aus CRM einen echten Wachstumstreiber zu machen?


Wofür du Verantwortung übernimmst



CRM lief bei uns bisher nebenbei – jetzt wollen wir daraus einen echten Wachstumstreiber machen. 

  • Du baust unsere CRM- und Lifecycle-Strategie auf: Du entwickelst Prozesse, Tools und Strukturen von Grund auf und richtest sie auf Kundenbindung und Wiederkäufe aus.
  • Du entwickelst unsere Lifecycle-Flows: In Klaviyo konzipierst und optimierst du automatisierte Customer Journeys von Welcome und Post-Purchase bis Cross-/Upselling und Win-back.
  • Du entwickelst relevante Kundensegmente: Leads und Kund:innen segmentierst du nach Kaufverhalten, Interessen und Lifecycle-Phase für eine gezielte Kundenansprache.
  • Du verantwortest unsere CRM-Kampagnen: Du steuerst Themen, Timing und Versand und stimmst dich eng mit Marketing und E-Commerce ab.
  • Du etablierst eine Test- und Lernkultur: Mit strukturierten A/B-Tests identifizierst du Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst unsere CRM-Maßnahmen kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Du steuerst die CRM-Performance: Relevante KPIs und Reportings nutzt du, um Erfolge messbar zu machen und konkrete Maßnahmen abzuleiten.
  • Du stellst Datenqualität und Compliance sicher: Du sorgst für sauberes Listenmanagement und DSGVO-konforme CRM-Prozesse.
  • Du identifizierst die größten CRM-Hebel: Potenziale priorisierst du nach Business Impact und entwickelst perspektivisch weitere Retention-Programme wie Loyalty und Referral.


Womit du punkten kannst

Du kennst CRM nicht nur aus der Theorie. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im CRM-, Lifecycle- oder Retention-Marketing mit und weißt, wie aus Kundendaten relevante Kommunikation und messbare Kundenbindung entsteht. Dabei wartest du nicht auf Vorgaben, sondern erkennst Potenziale und setzt sie eigenständig um.

  • Du kennst CRM aus der Praxis: Du bringst ca. 4+ Jahre Erfahrung mit, idealerweise im E-Commerce- oder D2C-Umfeld, und hast eine CRM-Funktion bereits aufgebaut oder maßgeblich weiterentwickelt.

  • Du denkst datengetrieben: Du verstehst relevante CRM-KPIs, erkennst Zusammenhänge und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen zur Steigerung von Kundenbindung und Umsatz ab.
  • Du behältst den Überblick und setzt Prioritäten: Kampagnen, Flows, Tests und neue Ideen gleichzeitig bringen dich nicht aus dem Takt. Du entscheidest eigenständig, wo der größte Hebel liegt.

  • Du kommunizierst souverän: Du arbeitest eng mit unterschiedlichen Teams zusammen und kannst dich auf Deutsch sehr sicher und klar verständigen.

  • du lange Freigabeprozesse einer schnellen, direkten Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsführung vorziehst.

description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As the (Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany, your first focus is optimising the performance, positioning, and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within our largest and most established market while adding new products to it and making sure our new customer-facing features get seen. You will take ownership of what's already working and what isn't, fine-tuning pricing, packaging, and go-to-market execution while working closely across Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing to keep the German market performing at its full potential.

  • You own the performance and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within the German market, working to continuously optimise what's already in place rather than build from zero.
  • You fine-tune pricing and packaging, identify where existing structures are leaving value on the table, and drive the changes needed to capture it.
  • You bring new positioning ideas to an already mature market, testing and validating fresh angles alongside the initiatives already running.
  • You develop a deep understanding of the unit economics behind Heartbeat AI in Germany, using that insight to shape monetisation strategy across pricing, packaging, and the broader product suite.
  • You work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, translating technical constraints into commercial decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements.
  • You track performance across the German market, using data to spot where monetisation or positioning is underperforming and turning that into concrete action.
  • You operate with significant cross-functional influence, managing diagonally across tech, sales, and marketing to keep initiatives moving.
  • You report into the Go-to-Market Director, working closely with senior leadership to present performance updates and build the case for changes to positioning or monetisation strategy.

Dein Profil

  • You bring at least 5 years of experience in a similar commercial, product, or GTM role, ideally within the tech and energy industry.
  • You are confident optimising an already-established market, spotting where fine-tuning pricing, packaging, or positioning can unlock further performance.
  • You are structured by default and follow through without being asked: you manage multiple concurrent initiatives and dependencies without losing the thread, and own action items end to end.
  • You are ambitious and impact-driven, yet humble and a strong influencer in equal measure. You set a high bar for what "good" looks like, quickly credit the team and admit when something isn't working, and can bring sceptical stakeholders on board to inspire the cross-functional effort to scale the German market.
  • You have a strong grasp of unit economics and a genuine passion for how they drive monetisation decisions, and you can translate margin and cost-structure insights into concrete pricing and product strategy.
  • You are comfortable working closely with Tech, Sales and Marketing teams and fluent in both sales/marketing and technology language, translating technical trade-offs into business decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements, without needing someone else to broker the conversation.
  • You are confident presenting to and working directly with executives and can turn data and KPIs into clear, decision-ready updates.
  • You are native in German and fluent in English (C1/C2), written and verbal.
  • Knowledge of and experience in the German energy market is clearly a plus, but not a must.

Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups

title: Tech Lead - AI & Innovation
description:
Vicoland gives the professional services market a new dimension: Virtual Companies – "Vicos". We invented Vicos as a new type of supplier, more efficient than traditional professional services firms (consultancies, system integrators, agencies etc.). We have received 20 million € in round A financing.

Vicos may consist of freelancers, SMEs and AI agents. They organize through our AI-driven SaaS platform to act like real companies, competing successfully for large enterprise projects, e g. ERP introductions or AI transformations. Vicos have proven to be more cost-efficient and to deliver better quality than traditional companies.

Already, 120+ Vicos with thousands of freelancers work on projects for enterprise clients like BASF, Miele, Siemens or Daimler and many SME. Forbes and Forrester have named Vicoland as a leading force transforming the market.

Our certified platform is key to our success. It provides the full digital infrastructure which makes Vicos come true as a new form to organize human labor and human-agentic interaction. It covers end-to-end all essential areas: marketing, finance, legal, and organization.

Given its ambitious and transformative purpose, our platform is highly complex (though easy use). Developing it further takes engineers who combine technical excellence, pragmatic judgement and entrepreneurial spirit. The Tech Lead: AI & Innovation we are looking for embodies these qualities in his or her leadership. He or she is up for making a major contribution to our company and to our society.

Tasks

  • You will lead, grow and enable a team of (forward deployed) engineers: make every engineer successful in their role and hire new ones who strengthen the team.
  • You will be the only (and main) tech lead for the engineering team, with carreer option to progress to CTO
  • Own the technical direction and technology decisions for Vicoland. Set the architecture across the stack, from frontend to infrastructure, and make sure what we build is scalable, robust and maintainable.
  • Stay hands-on: contribute features yourself end-2-end by understanding business needs, coding, building prototypes, and for all that using AI to aggressively ship high-quality software alongside your team.
  • Translate business needs into technical roadmaps in close cooperation with Business Development, Product and other stakeholders. Prioritize, scope and make trade-offs explicit.
  • Makre sure each team member can work end-to-end: concept & design, development, QA, deployment and production monitoring, with clear engineering standards and quality gates.
  • Continuously improve how we build with AI: best practices for context engineering, model selection, evaluation, tracing and observability, so that quality is measured, not assumed.
  • Run architectural discussions, code reviews and retrospectives; create a culture of ownership, constructive challenge and continuous learning.
  • Act as a sparring partner to the Chief Product Officer and the business leadership team on technology strategy, build-vs-buy decisions and team setup.

Requirements

  • Have proven people leadership experience: you have led an engineering team (ideally 3+ engineers), including hiring, performance evaluations, career development and coaching.
  • Have excelled somewhere through an impactful technical contribution, one which we can talk about, and still enjoy writing code yourself.
  • Have deep hands-on experience across the stack (frontend, backend, data, infrastructure/cloud) and a track record of architecting and shipping production-grade software, preferably with AI components (LLMs, embeddings, RAG pipelines, autonomous agents, PyTorch/TensorFlow).
  • Have experience developing AI agents and integrating them into business workflows.
  • Be on top of the latest tools, models and trends in AI-assisted software engineering. You are excellent at context engineering (incl. prompting), know when to leverage which model, and have first-hand experience with Claude Code or Cursor, and you know how to roll these practices out across a team.
  • Know how to evaluate what gets built. You can design eval sets, work with LLM-as-judge or ground-truth data, use tracing and observability tooling to find and fix regressions, and make evaluation a team habit.
  • Practice a truly agnostic approach to stack and tools: you pick the right tech for the problem, not vice versa, and can explain your choices to both engineers and business stakeholders.
  • Balance autonomy and alignment: you drive your team from idea to finished product independently, while knowing when to involve, align with or escalate to others.
  • Have the ability to thoughtfully challenge ideas and drive constructive discussions with users, engineers, product, and business leadership.
  • Lead with humility: you create psychological safety, give and receive honest feedback, and measure your success by the success of your team.
  • Reside within ±3 hours of Central European Time (to enable effective collaboration), at best in one of our office locations in Barcelona, Berlin, Frankfurt, Leipzig, and Sevilla.
  • Full professional proficiency in English at C2 level.
  • Full professional proficiency in German at C1 level.

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling an engineering team in a startup or scale-up environment.
  • Prior experience integrating AI into SaaS business workflows, ideally in a client-facing or forward-deployed setup.
  • Familiarity with the modern AI-tooling ecosystem (agents, memory systems, vector databases, orchestration frameworks).
  • Experience working with distributed or multi-location teams.

Benefits

  • You’ll work in an international, closely knit team of high‑performers and entrepreneurial spirits.
  • Remote‑friendly + flexible work hours.
  • Excellent compensation + participation in the company through our ESOP.
  • Growth mindset: Hard skills are important — but mindset matters more. If you meet most of the requirements and you’re hungry to learn, apply anyway.

If you’re a high‑impact tech lead who thrives on autonomy, drives real results, and is passionate about applying AI to change how teams work - let’s talk. Even if you don’t check every bullet above, but you bring exceptional drive, creativity, and a growth mindset, please apply. We believe the right mindset counts more than checkboxes.

title: Product Feature Owner ADAS
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Feature Owner Team

Wayve’s Product & Delivery team turns our AI Driver technology into valuable, scalable vehicle capabilities for global OEM partners. We work at the intersection of customer needs, product strategy and engineering delivery—defining what great looks like, aligning teams around a clear outcome and ensuring that Wayve’s technology can be brought to market safely and effectively.

As part of this team, you’ll take end-to-end ownership of specific Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping ADAS functionalities. You’ll work closely with OEM customers, product and engineering teams to define feature scope, set performance targets and guide delivery from concept through to production. Your work will directly shape how Wayve’s technology performs for customers and drivers as we progress towards higher levels of autonomy.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Act as the accountable product owner for specific ADAS features, ensuring they are delivered on time, to the agreed specification and in line with customer and business needs.

  • Partner closely with OEM customers to understand their requirements, represent their needs internally and align expectations without compromising Wayve’s product strategy.

  • Work with feature group owners and engineering teams to define feature scope, specifications, performance targets and delivery plans.

  • Engage throughout feature development, providing early feedback, participating in testing and supporting evaluation and validation activities.

  • Serve as the central point of coordination between OEMs, product and engineering teams, creating clarity, resolving ambiguity and reducing misunderstandings.

  • Identify risks early, manage trade-offs and keep teams aligned as feature requirements, customer priorities and the technology evolve.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of ADAS features across Collision Avoidance and Lane Keeping, including Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB), Lane Keeping Assist (LKA), Evasive Steering Assist (ESA), Automatic Emergency Steering (AES) and Blind Spot Monitoring (BSM).

  • Defining and evolving feature specifications in partnership with OEMs, engineering and product teams.

  • Harmonising customer requirements across OEM partners to maximise reusable assets, scalability and efficient feature delivery.

  • Setting clear performance targets and ensuring features meet customer requirements, internal capabilities and agreed delivery specifications.

  • Supporting testing, evaluation and validation to ensure feature quality and readiness for production.

  • Maintaining and evolving the strategic feature roadmap as Wayve’s technology advances towards higher levels of autonomy.

  • Participating in agile planning and delivery rituals, helping teams manage dependencies, risks and priorities effectively.

  • Ensuring feature delivery aligns with relevant automotive quality, safety and compliance expectations.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have strong experience specifying and delivering ADAS features from concept through to production, particularly across Collision Avoidance or Lane Keeping functions such as AEB, LKA, ESA, AES or BSM.

  • You understand automotive development processes, including requirements management, the V-model, ASPICE, quality and validation.

  • You are confident working directly with OEM customers: understanding their needs, negotiating requirements and representing their perspective internally while maintaining a clear view of Wayve’s product strategy.

  • You have sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with engineering teams on feature trade-offs, feasibility, testing, evaluation and validation.

  • You are a strong cross-functional collaborator who can bridge technical and commercial perspectives, creating alignment across customers, product and engineering teams.

  • You proactively identify risks and issues before they escalate, balancing immediate delivery needs with the longer-term product roadmap.

  • You are comfortable in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment and can bring structure and clarity without adding unnecessary process.

  • Experience shipping complete ADAS features into large-scale automotive production programmes would be valuable.

  • Knowledge of automotive quality, safety and compliance standards—including ASPICE, SOTIF, functional safety, GSR-II and DCAS—would be valuable.

  • Experience with machine learning, LLMs or recent generative-AI methods and architectures would be beneficial.

  • You bring curiosity and a forward-looking approach to developing new ADAS capabilities and advancing the customer experience.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

This is a full-time role based in our Leonberg office. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces and workshops with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency interviews (HM Interview) 45 Minutes

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (ADAS domain knowledge, Technical Depth and Presentation)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve
